mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory ( inventory_id, drug_id, warehouse_id, batch_no, quantity, validity_date ) VALUES ( #{inventory_id}, #{drug_id}, #{warehouse_id}, #{batch_no}, #{quantity}, #{validity_date} )
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET drug_id = #{drug_id}, warehouse_id = #{warehouse_id}, batch_no = #{batch_no}, quantity = #{quantity}, validity_date = #{validity_date} WHERE inventory_id = #{inventory_id}
mapper.select: select * from inventory order by warehouse_id, drug_id
select * from inventory where validity_date <= #{days_before_expiry} and validity_date >= CURRENT_DATE() order by validity_date
